relevance_note: Case report of a girl with a de novo GFAP mutation: 'The patient was confirmed to harbor a novel mutation in the GFAP gene.' plus a literature table of 18 earlier mild infantile/asymptomatic cases.
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory transcribed Table 2 (cells, spans and footnote symbols) and I checked its output against the table row by row. In scope: the first-hand index patient (label 'patient'; she is also Table 2 row 18, Reference 'Present', so she has one row only, with table-derived bulbar signs, cognitive impairment and MRI type added to her) and the 18 previously published patients of Table 2, labelled 'Table 2 #<n>' from the unheaded numbering column (footnote symbols *, †, ¶, § stripped from the label). Table 2 legend: '+' is printed as '†, presence' (the dagger is used twice in the legend, also for 'absence of the mutation in both parents'); I read '+' cells as present using that legend entry as second span and '†' after a patient number as both parents negative (consistent with the index patient, 18†, whose parents tested negative in the text). '-' is defined as absence. Cells '-3+' (Spasticity and Cognitive impairment for #4, #5, #11, #13) appear to mean absent-then-present; recorded as not reported. Table 2 Mutation and Reference columns look like merged cells partly lost in conversion (mutation printed for rows 2-3, 5-6, 9, 11, 12, 14-15, 16, 19; blank for 1, 4, 7, 8, 10, 13, 17; reference blank for 3, 4, 6, 12, 17); I kept the literal row alignment and recorded blank cells as not reported (variant rows kept with 'not reported' because the footnote symbols tie a GFAP mutation to every row). Sex is blank for #4, #5, #6, #10, #13 and left not reported. Checklist mapping from Table 2: Seizures +/- to 'seizures'; Macrocephaly + and Spasticity + to the composite items, but '-' left not reported (narrower absence does not exclude a composite item); Bulbar signs and Cognitive impairment not mapped (bulbar signs is not specific to dysphagia or dysarthria; impairment is not decline). MRI 'T'/'A' recorded as features 'typical MRI'/'atypical MRI'. Index patient: brisk deep tendon reflexes recorded as a feature but 'spasticity or pyramidal signs' left not reported (no spasticity but brisk reflexes); 'ataxia or cerebellar signs' left not reported (only ataxia addressed); normal ophthalmologic examination recorded as stated and excludes nothing more specific. Variant type left not reported (the paper describes an alanine-to-valine change but does not name the class). Zygosity heterozygous from '1 of the patient's GFAP alleles'. Transcript recorded as the GenBank accession printed for the sequencing (XM 008388). Contradictions/discrepancies: text gives onset 3.5 months, Table 2 row 18 gives '3 m'; text lists MRIs at 20 months while Fig 1 and Table 1 say 19 months; text values used for the index patient. Publication year is not printed in the file (only 'Received November 17, 2005'); n_patients_reported left null because the authors state no total.
